description: Fetch the full police outcome history of up to 25 crimes by persistent_id — the 64-character id on crimes from ukcrime_search_crimes and ukcrime_search_outcomes. Returns each crime with every outcome, oldest first, and lists the ids data.police.uk does not hold. Anti-social behaviour records carry no persistent id.

persistent_ids.description: 1–25 persistent ids from the persistent_id field of ukcrime_search_crimes or ukcrime_search_outcomes results. A comma- or space-separated string is also accepted; ids are lower-cased and repeats dropped.

name: ukcrime_get_crime_outcomes

crimes.description: The crimes found, in the order their ids were given.

items.description: One crime and its outcome history.

history_available.description: False when data.police.uk publishes no outcome history for this crime (seen on Northern Ireland records); outcomes is then empty.

location.description: Absent when the crime has no location.

location_id.description: Map point id; pass it as location_id with area 'location'.

map_point.description: Anonymised point covering at least eight addresses, not where it happened. Absent when unpublished.

subtype.description: Station or premises type, when published.

type.description: 'BTP': a British Transport Police station record; 'Force': a territorial force's.

outcomes.description: Every police outcome recorded for the crime, oldest first.

persistent_id.description: The persistent id this record was fetched by.

data_note.description: What these records can and cannot say; read it first.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `rate_limited`: data.police.uk is rate-limiting this server for longer than this call can wait. `pacer_shed`: too many requests to data.police.uk are already queued in this server. `upstream_unavailable`: data.police.uk is not answering. `retry_deadline_exceeded`: data.police.uk did not answer within the time one call allows. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

failed.description: Ids whose lookup still failed after retries for a reason other than a missing crime (outage, timeout, rate limit). Empty when none.

guidance.description: What to do about ids in not_found or failed; absent when every id resolved.

not_found.description: Ids data.police.uk holds no crime for.

title: Get UK Crime Outcome Histories
